description: The sign-in commands boopis may run on a form's behalf, by provider id. A form (an agent's, a teammate's, a mod's) names a provider and never a command: the host looks the provider up here and runs exactly this program and argument vector, as a vector, never through a shell. Every entry is a real login command of a tool Hermes or a collection entry uses, checked on the date in `verified` against the sources listed. `program` "hermes" means the Hermes the host runs (its own path and home). Not here on purpose: any Claude subscription sign-in (Anthropic's terms do not allow third-party apps to route through plan credentials). `gh auth login` is left out too: its browser flow prints a one-time code the user must read while it runs, and boopis shows a command's output only when it ends. See docs/CONNECTORS.md.

sources: gcloud auth login --help (Google Cloud SDK 570.0.0): `gcloud auth login [ACCOUNT] [--no-activate] [--brief] ...`; the default is a browser flow that returns to a localhost address, so no code is read from the terminal
hermes auth add --help (Hermes v0.23.2): `hermes auth add [--type {oauth,api-key}] provider`
hermes_cli/auth_commands.py v0.23.2, `_add_nous_oauth_credential`: the device-code login Hermes keeps in its own credential pool
hermes auth add --help (Hermes v0.23.2): names openai-codex as a provider id
hermes_cli/auth_commands.py v0.23.2: `openai-codex` is in `_OAUTH_CAPABLE_PROVIDERS` and has its own branch in `_add_credential`
